assertions.evidence: In src/incident-urgency.ts, URGENCY_QUESTION has type: "score" with an ordered criteria array of five levels ("1 — Informational..." to "5 — Critical impact"), not a choice over digits.

parseResponse derives urgency from answer.probabilities by selecting the max-probability level and returning Number(urgency), and rateIncident makes a single Decisions API call; the test confirms the most probable level is chosen.
The request sends state: { incident: { report: string, service: string } }, keeping report text and service name as separate named fields (test asserts sent.state.incident.service === "checkout").
